questions.cardText:
[Zoology] What does it mean when a dog tilts their head when you speak to them?
A. They are paying attention to you
B. They are waiting for a command
C. They are mimicking you
Answer: A. Recent studies suggest that this behavior emerges only upon hearing familiar words, indicating that dogs are processing relevant auditory stimuli and trying to understand.
questions.de: Was deutet laut einer Studie von 2021, in der Hunde Spielzeuge auf Zuruf holen sollten, ein schief gelegter Kopf beim Hund an, wenn man mit ihm spricht?
questions.en: According to a 2021 study in which dogs were asked to fetch toys by name, what does a dog's head tilt when you speak to it suggest?
questions.answerDe: Dass er auf Wörter achtet, die er kennt
questions.answerEn: That it is paying attention to words it knows

timeline.labelEn: Animal Cognition publishes an exploratory study linking head-tilting in dogs to attention to known words
timeline.labelDe: Animal Cognition veröffentlicht eine explorative Studie, die das Kopfschiefhalten von Hunden mit Aufmerksamkeit für bekannte Wörter verbindet

source.title: An exploratory analysis of head-tilting in dogs (Sommese et al., Animal Cognition 2021)

questions.notes: Sommese et al. 2021 (40 dogs): only dogs that had learned the toys' names tilted their heads frequently when asked to fetch them; authors suggest a link to attention and processing meaningful stimuli. The card's 'only upon hearing familiar words' overstates an exploratory result; 'paying attention' is a hypothesis. Date = online publication per Crossref.

questions.cardText:
[Music] Who composed the music for the opera “The Magic Flute”?
A. Ludwig van Beethoven
B. Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
C. Giuseppe Verdi
Answer: B. Mozart wrote this opera during the last year of his life, and its premiere was just two months before his death.
questions.de: Wer komponierte die Musik zur Oper „Die Zauberflöte“, die nur zwei Monate vor dem Tod ihres Komponisten uraufgeführt wurde?
questions.en: Who composed the music for the opera The Magic Flute, which premiered just two months before its composer's death?

timeline.labelEn: Mozart's opera The Magic Flute premieres at the Theater auf der Wieden in Vienna
timeline.labelDe: Mozarts Oper „Die Zauberflöte“ wird im Freihaus-Theater auf der Wieden in Wien uraufgeführt

questions.notes: Premiered 30 September 1791 in Vienna, two months before Mozart's death (5 December 1791); libretto by Emanuel Schikaneder (Wikipedia).
